expected value after shrinkage toward the market is only -0.7% (< 1%)
edge +0.7% below the 4% minimum (starting goalie unconfirmed); model win probability 33.3% below the 40% confidence floor

evidence: log loss +0.0108 (95% interval +0.0003 to +0.0200). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

208 picks, ROI +1.7% (95% interval -9.3% to +11.9%), win rate 60.1% against a break-even 58.6%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 17% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.09 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,936 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,777; a 1% edge takes 44,418. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
